note: Baseline calibrated from 2 real runs (n=2) after the Sonnet revert on 2026-08-24. A third calibration run was attempted but blocked by an Anthropic API billing/credit limit (see docs/evaluation/regression.md). Recalibrate this file once at least 5 runs are available for a statistically meaningful stdev — treat the current tolerance as a conservative starting point, not a final number.

hard_floor.source: Pre-existing project gate, .specify/memory/constitution.md — not chosen by this calibration

tolerance.method: baseline_mean - tolerance, floored by hard_floor. Tolerance set conservatively above ~3x the n=2 empirical stdev (faithfulness: 3x0.0184=0.055, rounded down slightly; relevancy: 3x0.0028=0.0085, widened to 0.03 to avoid over-fitting a 2-sample stdev). Both values are far below the ~0.14-0.17 drop observed in the actual Haiku regression, so the check would have caught that regression with wide margin while tolerating normal judge-to-judge noise.
